author: Second Wind
description:
This video is brought to you by Full Circle, a JRPG inspired by the classics of the PS1 era, set in a world where humanity fled to the skies in an attempt to outrun their destiny. – https://store.steampowered.com/app/1439270/Full_Circle/

How do you keep excitement levels high at the table over a long journey? Or keep combat engaging after multiple rounds? How many goblin arsonists makes an encounter too predictable? If you're a DM, you make encounters and adventures, so let's talk about how to make them great with the help of Tiger Wizard from Exalted Funeral. So ask all your adventure-crafting questions today! Also Jesse Galena will be there.
